patient.title: Vinorelbine and cisplatin · 21-day cycle
patient.purpose: After surgery, treatment aims to lower the chance of cancer returning. For advanced or recurrent lung cancer, it aims to control disease and symptoms. Your team should mark which goal applies to you; benefit is not guaranteed.

agents.name: Vinorelbine
agents.mechanism: Disrupts microtubules needed for cell division
agents.explanation: Vinorelbine disrupts the cell structures that help divide chromosomes. This can slow cancer growth and also affect blood cells, nerves and the bowel.
agents.watch: Report fever, constipation, numbness or pain at the infusion site promptly.
risks: Low blood counts and serious infection

agents.name: Cisplatin
agents.explanation: Cisplatin forms links in DNA that interfere with copying and repair. This helps stop cancer cells dividing, but healthy tissues may also be affected. Kidney protection with fluids and monitoring is central to cisplatin treatment.
agents.watch: Report ringing in the ears, hearing changes, numbness or loss of function. Tell the team if you cannot drink, are passing less urine or become swollen or breathless during fluids.
risks: Low blood counts, infection and bleeding
Hearing changes or tinnitus, which can persist
Numbness or tingling, which can persist
Electrolyte changes and need for hydration

support.title: Prevent and manage sickness
support.text: Follow your prescribed anti-sickness and constipation-prevention plan. Cisplatin days need kidney-protecting fluids and electrolyte checks. Do not repeat the full cisplatin anti-sickness course on a vinorelbine-only day unless prescribed.

support.title: Bowel care
support.text: Take the prescribed laxative plan. Tell the team if your bowels slow down; severe pain, swelling or vomiting needs urgent advice.

support.title: Protect kidneys, hearing and nerves
support.text: Follow your individual drinking advice and report reduced urine, ringing ears, hearing changes or tingling. Ask before taking new medicines or supplements.

questions.q: What if a weekly dose is missed?
questions.a: The team decides whether to omit, delay or change a dose. Do not add a missed dose yourself; the two vinorelbine/cisplatin schedules have different rules.

medicines.name: Aprepitant
medicines.dose: 125 mg orally Day 1; 80 mg orally Days 2–3
medicines.timing: Before SACT on Day 1, then daily on Days 2–3
medicines.note: Aprepitant inhibits CYP3A4 and can increase vinca toxicity; prescriber/pharmacy must review the combination and monitor.

medicines.name: Antiemetic dexamethasone reference
medicines.dose: 12 mg orally Day 1; 8 mg orally daily Days 2–4
medicines.note: Reconcile the antiemetic course and interactions into one prescription; this is a reference course requiring local confirmation.

medicines.name: Olanzapine
medicines.note: General high-risk NCIS reference; review sedation, falls, metabolic risk and interaction with metoclopramide. Consultant may individualise.

medicines.name: Metoclopramide
medicines.dose: 10 mg orally three times daily as prescribed
medicines.note: NCIS row does not specify an end day or PRN qualifier; prescriber/pharmacy must specify duration and suitability. Co-prescribing with olanzapine increases extrapyramidal risk; assess neurological contraindications and interactions.

support.title: Prevent and manage sickness
support.text: Follow your prescribed anti-sickness and constipation-prevention plan. Cisplatin days need kidney-protecting fluids and electrolyte checks. Do not repeat the full cisplatin anti-sickness course on a vinorelbine-only day unless prescribed.

support.text: Take the prescribed laxative plan. Tell the team if your bowels slow down; severe pain, swelling or vomiting needs urgent advice.

support.title: Protect kidneys, hearing and nerves
support.text: Follow your individual drinking advice and report reduced urine, ringing ears, hearing changes or tingling. Ask before taking new medicines or supplements.

questions.q: What if a weekly dose is missed?
questions.a: The team decides whether to omit, delay or change a dose. Do not add a missed dose yourself; the two vinorelbine/cisplatin schedules have different rules.

medicines.note: NCIS row does not specify an end day or PRN qualifier; prescriber/pharmacy must specify duration and suitability. Co-prescribing with olanzapine increases extrapyramidal risk; assess neurological contraindications and interactions.
